name: Ollivier & Company
story: Kim Ollivier’s consultancy supplied geospatial consulting and training and participated in early web-data distribution. It was listed among New Zealand geospatial businesses in the 2013 market review.

Eagle’s partner directory describes Ollivier & Company’s specialism in Esri applications for local and regional government, with principal Kim Ollivier bringing a civil-engineering background. NIWA separately credits Ollivier’s MPI marine-planning tool as the inspiration for its Structured Conservation Planning QGIS plugin. That account documents work spanning client consulting and a method later carried into open-source software.
